label: canon-b18-gm-tb
_why: THE TIE-BREAKER of canon_b18_gm_n2.json: the third run of the 2+1 rule, launched ONLY when alignment_check.mjs exits 2 on that pair. Read as its own session and pooled with the pair (--arm sessA,sessB:canon-b18-gm); the configuration is then the MEDIAN OF THREE. The book, the lever (B 1.8 gain-matched per era, rung 0 untouched), the predictions and the branches are those of canon_b18_gm_n2.json.

_arms.canon-b18-gm: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.canon-b18-gm.json} - the same book as the pair's, byte-identical.

_alignment: Pool with the pair: `node tools/testbed/ledger/alignment_check.mjs --arm <sessA>,<sessB>:canon-b18-gm`; the run-level stop and the capital-abundance flag apply.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30); the STOP file must be absent; the five-minute smoke check.
